facilities.name: Accommodation
facilities.description: Accommodation in Lower Ahobilam at the Malola Guest House run by the Muth and various community rest houses (satrams) at budget-friendly rates.

facilities.name: Doli (Palanquin) Services
facilities.description: Doli (palanquin) services available for hire at Lower Ahobilam to transport elderly and disabled pilgrims to the steep upper hill shrines.

facilities.name: Free Food (Annadanam)
facilities.description: Free food distribution three times a day by the Annamacharya Nitya Annadanam Trust (Curd Rice in the morning and evening, full course meals at noon).

facilities.name: First-aid Center
facilities.description: Basic first-aid center and emergency medical desk located at Lower Ahobilam near the guest house.

facilities.name: Trained Local Guides
facilities.description: Trained local guides available for hire at nominal rates to navigate forest trekking trails, especially to Jwala Narasimha and Ugra Sthambham.

facilities.name: Restrooms and Toilet Blocks
facilities.description: Restrooms and toilet blocks located near the guest houses and parking zones.

facilities.name: Spacious Parking
facilities.description: Spacious parking grounds for buses, cars, and private vehicles at Lower Ahobilam.
